name: Local Account Created or Added to Administrators (Windows)
description: A local user was created (4720) or added to the local Administrators / Remote Desktop Users group (4732), or net.exe/net1.exe was used to do so. Common persistence + privilege step.
query: event.code:"4720" or (event.code:"4732" and group.name:("Administrators" or "Remote Desktop Users" or "Backup Operators")) or (event.provider:"Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and event.code:"1" and process.name:("net.exe" or "net1.exe") and process.command_line:(*"user "* and *"/add"* or *"localgroup administrators"*))
tags: Data Source: Windows Security Event Logs
false_positives: Sanctioned local account provisioning by imaging/onboarding automation.
note:
### Triage
- Which account, by whom, on which host?
- New account immediately added to Administrators is high confidence — correlate with remote logons.
